note: The live autoplay game, played on the Meridian world (meridian-v1.0.3) under rules 0.9, where a house reads the map at its own personal year. seed and started_season are written by `python -m hoc sim new --seed N`, which founds the first house in season 1 by the engine's own draw; until then every seed CSV holds only its header row.
